text: Detection assembly remains a pure Machine consumer. Detection.run executes the existing machine, rejects fallible emissions, derives half-open SampleRange support from event intervals, validates frame/clock/source coherence through EventSeries, then overlays event classes without erasing native Blink, Missing, or OffSurface states. GapPolicy.Break rejects events spanning invalid support; Bridge accepts only invalid runs within its validated bound and reports them; UseInterpolatedOnly permits usable samples explicitly marked Interpolated but rejects native invalid gaps. All uncovered usable samples and represented durations remain Unclassified and produce operand-rich warnings. Recording content identity plus detector name/version, source, gap policy, and validated parameters feed provenance. Detector-specific repairs remain responsible for producing semantically valid intervals; this assembler fails contradictory output closed.
